statement: Guide is about talent priority order rather than completing his full build; his character is higher level with more points than viewer
First priority in Tab 1 is Gilded Sword (percent boost to all damage); max it out as soon as possible
Second priority is Sharpened Axe for base Weapon Power increase which is one of the most important stats
Put at least 50 points into Idle Brawling before diminishing returns hit massively; spend elsewhere until spare points
Idle Brawling gives about 10% at 50 points and only about 17% at 100 points (diminishing returns)
Next priority is Meat Shank (damage based on Max HP); max it out as early as possible
After Meat Shank maxing comes Health Booster to benefit more from Meat Shank
Then put some points into Fist of Rage but return to it later due to Tab 3 talents
Book of the Wise is huge for Accuracy; top priority on character should always be 100% accuracy
Check Player Stats to ensure enough accuracy for current monsters and next one or two maps
Hidden multiplier lets Active Skills increase kills per hour offline; need enough points in them to max it
Put 25 points in each of the active skills to max the hidden offline kills multiplier (about 2.2x kills per hour)
Raise one active skill to about 45 points to get at least 50% chance to hit twice
First Tab 2 priority is Carry A Big Stick for large damage boost via Weapon Power
Next priority Strength in Numbers giving large damage from Meat Shank and other Strength sources; as many points as possible
After Strength in Numbers comes Health Overdrive to get more out of Meat Shank
Always have one point in Firmly Grasp It; an active skill giving about 15 Strength for one point
Each Firmly Grasp It level after the first gives 1 Strength similar to Absolute Unit so they have equal priority
Stress Tested Garb gives large Strength bonus scaling with base Strength from equipment; max it and Absolute Unit
With spare talent points fill up Firmly Grasp It for more Strength
Hungry for Gold boosts golden food gains but is marginal and needs many points to be worth it
Always have at least 25 points in Bear Swipe and Axe Hurl as they affect kills per hour
First Tab 3 priority is No Pain No Gain the largest boost a Barbarian gets from a single talent
Next priority Str Summore which allows more points into Fist of Rage on Tab 1; hence saving points
Apocalypse Zow gives damage per monster with at least 100000 kills; he has 50 such monsters giving 200% damage at 4% bonus
Easiest Apocalypse Zow break point is at 132 talent points; two more points raise 5% to 6%; stop at break points
Next break point at 165 points needs maxed Talent Library and Blood Berserker class unlocked to get extra talent points
Next priority Back To The Basics if you need more points in Tab 2 to raise active skills; add 25 points
Then choose between Multi-Kill for portals or Death Note increase; his priority lately is Death Note via Monster Decimator
Strongest Statues and Fistful of Obols give slight damage increase depending on quality of obols and statues; leftovers go there
With enough overall points level Critikill in Tab 1 for extra crit damage based on points invested
After adding Str Summore points
explicit: add another 127 points into Fist of Rage for more Strength

statement: Then max Book of the Wise for more accuracy and take movement speed talent
Leftover points go into Lucky Clover for extra drop rate

statement: About 20 points into each when highest classes are just under level 200; fewer points if characters are lower level
Next big star priority is Tick Tock for large AFK gain rate bonus
Next are Attacks on Simmer for more AFK kills and Goblet of Hemoglobin for survivability
Dungeonic Damage gives damage based on dungeon credits earned; more dungeon runs make it stronger
Next priority Frothy Malk for more bonuses from foods
Then Telekinetic Storage to increase carry capacity
At least one point in Printer Sampling and Shrine Architect so you can place shrines; everything after is optional
Crit Overkill gives more crit chance and crit damage; he is close to unlocking it; take if unlocked with spare points
Just EXP gives more class XP while leveling
Quest Chungus gives luck per completed quest; he completed about 150 so puts points until it exceeds quests completed
Check completed quests in Codex then Quest Log and scroll down
Pulsation helps mana regeneration if actively playing
Cardiovascular! gives more cards
Make sure you assign attacks you put points into; it increases gains overall
Have each ability assigned to the Attack Bar so they are used while offline
When leveling gear prioritize Weapon Damage first then enough Accuracy then Strength to keep increasing damage
Movement Speed and Crit Chance are nice only if excess; otherwise lower priority
